name: logo-design
description: Use this skill when the user asks a design agent to design, create, generate, redesign, refine, critique, or explore a logo, wordmark, monogram, brand mark, symbol, lockup, favicon, or app icon — or to turn a raster logo into an SVG. It generates one vector symbol and builds a complete production logo pack from it (lockups, app icon, monochrome, reverse, favicon) as scalable SVGs and transparent PNGs, using bundled scripts that guarantee a byte-identical mark across every asset. It also teaches logo judgment: mark architecture, typographic register, small-size discipline, and presentation.
human_description: Generate a consistent, production-ready logo pack.
